rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.noFetch: No fetch has run yet. The first one starts when the server starts.
rates.footer: Foreign transactions use the rate for their date, or the preceding published rate on weekends and holidays. Past rates are never downloaded, so a date the server missed stays without a rate.

tax.title: Income tax
tax.label: {kind} (%)
tax.hint: Whole percentages the investment income page uses to estimate tax. The defaults are the Slovak resident rates: 7 % on dividends and 19 % on interest and cashback.

passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Each user has a separate, encrypted ledger and their own Trading 212 key. TypeSafe and Resend are shared.
users.temporaryHint: Share it with the user. They must choose their own password when they first sign in.
users.resetDescription: The user is signed out and must choose a new password after signing in with this one.
users.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes the user and their whole ledger: accounts, transactions, imports and settings. It cannot be undone.
users.caption: Users of this workspace

signIns.title: Sign-ins
signIns.footer: Your active sessions, newest first. The location is approximate, taken from the IP address Cloudflare saw. If you do not recognise a sign-in, change your password to sign out every other session.
